findings.problem: Claim-22 assigns 宣和六年/AD 1124 to Shen Kuo (p003) on s0312 inside Wang Fu's Xuanhe memorial. That sentence cites 本朝沈括's clay-ball demonstration as historical precedent; it is a retrospective allusion, not Kuo's dated activity in 1124.
findings.action: Reclassify s0312 as retrospective reception (undated attestation or separate honor/reference) and drop AD 1124 from p003 active-date hints; retain 熙寧七年 dating from s0270–s0273.

findings.problem: Claim-32 dates Yixing (p011) to 宣和六年 July using s0298 ('自余悉如唐一行之制') under frame s0290. Yixing is cited for his Tang mechanism, not present in 1124.
findings.action: Remove explicit westernYear from this attestation or mark receptionType retrospective; keep active hints to Tang-period AD 721–727 only.

findings.problem: Claim-33 pins Zheng Xuan (p012) to AD 1124 via s0308 (鄭康成 on ji-heng terminology) within Wang Fu's 宣和六年 speech—a classical citation, not Han-period activity in 1124.
findings.action: Undate the attestation or encode as retrospective reference; trim AD 1124 from hints-p012.

findings.problem: Claim-34 assigns 宣和六年/AD 1124 to Yang Xiong (p013) for quoting 揚雄 on moon phases (s0309) inside the same memorial frame.
findings.action: Treat as undated classical quotation; retain AD 1–18 life-range hint only.

findings.problem: Claim-35 dates Jing Fang (p014) to AD 1124 from s0310 (京房's lunar-light dictum) under contextual s0290, conflating citation with personal activity.
findings.action: Remove 1124 attestation dating; keep BC 45–37 hint for historical activity.

claim-22.event: Shen Kuo cited for clay-ball moon model inside Wang Fu's Xuanhe 6 memorial.
claim-22.reason: s0312 本朝沈括用彈況月 appears only as Wang Fu's retrospective gloss within 宣和六年七月 (s0290); Kuo's experiment belongs to his own lifetime, not AD 1124 attestation activity.

claim-32.event: Tang Yixing cited for instrument mechanism in Wang Fu's memorial.
claim-32.reason: s0298 references 唐一行之制 as precedent within Wang Fu's 1124 report; importing 宣和六年 as Yixing's attestation year mis-owns the narrative frame.

claim-33.event: Zheng Xuan's Han commentary on ji-heng quoted in Xuanhe 6 speech.
claim-33.reason: s0308 cites 鄭康成's Han exegesis comparatively; 宣和六年七月 is Wang Fu's reporting date, not Zheng Xuan's.

claim-34.event: Yang Xiong quoted on lunar phases within Xuanhe memorial.
claim-34.reason: s0309 quotes 揚雄 without placing him in the Song narrative; contextual 1124 date from s0290 must not become Yang Xiong's personal attestation year.

claim-35.event: Jing Fang quoted on moonlight within same memorial.
claim-35.reason: s0310 京房云 is a classical citation embedded in Wang Fu's 宣和六年七月 address; AD 1124 is not Jing Fang's activity date.

hints-p003.event: Active-date hints for Shen Kuo include spurious AD 1124 from retrospective citation.
hints-p003.reason: Only 熙寧七年 activity (s0270–s0273) is source-supported in this chapter; AD 1124 traces to mis-owned claim-22 and must be dropped from hints.

hints-p011.event: Yixing hints carry AD 1124 from memorial citation.
hints-p011.reason: Chapter mention is retrospective; active hints should reflect Tang Yixing's own period (AD 721–727), not Wang Fu's reporting year.

hints-p012.event: Zheng Xuan hints incorrectly include AD 1124.
hints-p012.reason: Han scholar cited in s0308 without Song-dated activity; remove memorial-frame year from hints.

hints-p013.event: Yang Xiong hints incorrectly include AD 1124.
